title: Locator Preferences | datapack
description: Lets players chose how far away they want to be shown on the locator bar.
body: # Locator Preferences Control your waypoint transmit range on the locator bar with simple trigger commands. Perfect for servers where you want players to control their visibility on the locator bar. --- ## Commands | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `/trigger LP_disable` | Hide from all locator bars (0 blocks) | | `/trigger LP_reset` | Reset to default (60 million blocks) | | `/trigger LP_get` | Check your current range | | `/trigger LP_set set ` | Set custom range (1-60 million) | | `/trigger LP_help` | Show help menu | **Examples:** ``` /trigger LP_set set 100 # Short range /trigger LP_set set 10000 # Long range /trigger LP_disable # Hide from locator bars ``` ![help_menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9f07407985b549c49af3c7496b17e86a0d87c153.png) --- ## Installation 1. Download the datapack 2. Place in your world's `datapacks` folder 3. Run `/reload` or restart 4. Type `/trigger LP_help` to get started
